$comment: FAC-86's sample stateful widget: installs as a widget (kind), is never offered as an output format, and declares its local states in files/states.json. blueprintId is the install key: never rename it.
title: Status Widget
description: Use to show where one piece of work stands on an Operate console: idle, working, done or failed, with retry. A sample widget with local states; it reads and changes nothing outside itself.
